newsitem.title: PERU: Peru refinances 510 mln mark debt with Germany.
newsitem.headline: Peru refinances 510 mln mark debt with Germany.

text.p: Peru's official daily El Peruano said Friday the government had signed a 510 million-mark bilateral debt refinancing accord with Germany as part of a series of agreements negotiated with creditor nations of the Paris Club.
"Of this, up to 200 million marks can be swapped for projects to protect and conserve the environment or help fight poverty," El Peruano said.
It said Peruvian officials signed the accord with a four-member German Finance Ministry delegation in Lima.
The newspaper did not give interest or maturity details under the accord, and Economy Ministry officials were not immediately available to explain those details.
Peru has negotiated several bilateral accords since signing a preliminary restructuring agreement in July with 14 countries belonging to the Paris Club.
